additional_info.body:
Location
:
Alexela Jõhvi
Reported behavior/issue:
Customer reported that the charger socket was stuck in “Finishing”-mode 5h 26min after user left from site. This causes “penalty fee” for users even if their car is not anymore connected. This happens also elsewhere in Estonia and users are complaining about penalty fee due to socket stuck. Please see attached images.
I assume this is EcoG related FW issue? Do we have a fix for this?

Hello Markus﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Sominath

Product

ChargerID/Serial No.
:
1p1SHV
Problem Description
: Socket stuck in finishing - penalty fee running.
Troubleshooting
: We have analyzed the logs for the provided timestamp:
The charging session was stopped by pressing the Emergency Stop button when the State of Charge (SoC) was at 97%. However, Connector 3 remained stuck in the Finishing state instead of transitioning to the Faulted/Unavailable state until the emergency button was released. After releasing the emergency button, the charging session state changed to completed.
We are handing over this issue to our expert team, they will contact you shortly on this.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0370319
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
